# Hafez 
! [Caption for the image](/Users/amouzgar/phd/Rpackages/hafez/other/Hafez.jpg) 
## Hafez is a time-series analysis framework the performs landmark trajectory infernece and trajectory analysis strategies including cell density-based pseudotime normalization, time-series distance (TSD) clustering, and post-trajecory analysis methods that leverage the landmark framework.
